description: Draft a formal early-termination notice letter (text only - nothing is sent) with property, lease date, notice period, move-out date, fee and deposit lines, plus a subject and delivery tips. Use once the user has decided to leave early. Do NOT use to estimate costs - use estimate_break_cost.

break_fee_months.description: Break fee in months' rent to acknowledge in the letter, e.g. 2. Omit or 0 to ask for a reasonable arrangement instead

deposit.description: Security deposit amount to mention for return/inspection, e.g. 2200

landlord_name.description: Landlord or property manager name for the greeting. Default 'Landlord/Property Manager'

lease_date.description: Date the lease was signed or started, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2025-06-01. Omitted from the letter if not given

monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent amount quoted next to the break fee, e.g. 2200 (no currency symbol added)

notice_months.description: Notice period required by the lease, in months, positive, e.g. 2

property_address.description: Full address of the rental unit, e.g. 12 Lakeview Dr, Austin, TX

reason.description: Short reason for leaving, e.g. 'job relocation'; omitted if not given

tenant_name.description: Tenant's full name as on the lease; also used as the signature, e.g. Asha Rao

name: notice_letter

disclaimer.description: Informational, not-legal-advice disclaimer to show with the result

letter.description: Full plain-text notice letter ready to copy, review and send

sending_tips.description: Practical tips for delivering the notice and protecting yourself

subject.description: Suggested email subject / letter heading line

title: Notice letter
